title: Composition of canonical constant-ring maps on pro-etale sites
statement:
Let $h:Z\to W$ and $k:W\to V$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with the small pro-etale sites and universe conventions of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $A_T$ be its constant sheaf of rings on $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], for $T=Z,W,V$. Use the inverse images, their ring-sheaf adjunctions, and the canonical maps $c_A^f:f^{-1}A_{\mathrm{target}(f)}\to A_{\mathrm{source}(f)}$ adjoint to the constant-section maps $\rho_A^f$ of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. These maps are isomorphisms [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map]. Let $\alpha_{h,k}:(k\circ h)^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}h^{-1}k^{-1}$ be the canonical inverse-image comparison obtained by uniqueness of left adjoints from the direct-image comparison induced by $Z\times_W(W\times_VT)\cong Z\times_VT$ for each pro-etale $T\to V$. Then the specified constant-ring maps satisfy
$$
 c_A^{k\circ h}=c_A^h\circ h^{-1}(c_A^k)\circ\alpha_{h,k,A_V}:
 (k\circ h)^{-1}A_V\longrightarrow A_Z.
$$
